           any.

           the combination, which represent the lowest level at which the                    管 理，商 譽 將 在 最 底 層 被 監 控，而
           goodwill is monitored for internal management purposes and not                    且不超過營運分部層級。
           larger than an operating segment.

           A cash-generating unit (or group of cash-generating units) to                     獲分配商譽之現金產生單位（或該組
           which goodwill has been allocated is tested for impairment                        現金產生單位）會每年，或在有跡象
           annually or more frequently when there is indication that the unit                顯示有關單位可能出現減值時更頻
           may be impaired. For goodwill arising on an acquisition in a                      繁 地 進 行 測 試。就 於 報 告 期 內 進 行
           reporting period, the cash-generating unit (or group of cash-                     收 購 所 產 生 的 商 譽 而 言，獲 分 配 商
           generating units) to which goodwill has been allocated is tested                  譽之現金產生單位（或該組現金產生
           for impairment before the end of that reporting period. If the                    單位）會於該報告期末前進行減值測
           recoverable amount is less than its carrying amount, the                          試。倘 可 收 回 金 額 少 於 其 賬 面 值，
           impairment loss is allocated first to reduce the carrying amount                  減值虧損首先會以減少任何商譽之
           of any goodwill and then to the other assets on a pro-rata basis                  賬面值來分配，其後以該單位（或該

           of cash-generating units).                                                        為基準按比例分配至其他資產。

           Provision is recognised when the Group has a present obligation                    本集團若因過往事件而有現存責任
           (legal or constructive) as a result of a past event, it is probable               （法 定 或 推 定），並 且 本 集 團 可 能 將

           reliable estimate can be made of the amount of obligation.                         作出可靠估計，則會確認撥備。

           The amount recognised as provision is the best estimate of the                     撥 備 之 確 認 金 額，乃 經 考 慮 圍 繞 責
           consideration required to settle the present obligation at the end                 任 之 風 險 及 不 確 定 因 素 後，對 報 告
           of the reporting period, taking into account the risks and                         期結束時履行現存責任所需代價之
           uncertainties surrounding the obligation. When a provision is                      最 佳 估 計 值。當 使 用 履 行 現 存 責 任
           measured using the cash flows estimated to settle the present                      的 估 計 現 金 流 量 計 算 撥 備 時，其 賬
           obligation, its carrying amount is the present value of those cash                 面值為現金流量的現值（倘貨幣時間
           flows (where the effect of the time value of money is material).                   值之影響屬重大）。

           Provisions for the expected cost of assurance-type warranty                        於相關貨品銷售合約下保證型保修
           obligations under the relevant contract for sale of goods are                      責 任 預 期 成 本 的 撥 備，乃 於 銷 售 相
           recognised at the date of sale of the relevant products, at the                    關產品當日按董事對履行本集團責
           directors’ best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the                 任所需支出的最佳估計確認。
           Group’s obligation.

6.    SEGMENT INFORMATION                                                        6.   分部資料
      The Group is organised into operating business units according to the           本集團乃根據貨品銷售或提供服務之性質
      nature of the goods sold or services provided. The Group determines its         分類出營運業務單位。因此，本集團根據
      operating segments based on these business units by reference to the            業務單位所銷售之貨品或所提供之服務決
      goods sold or services provided, for the purpose of reporting to the            定其營運分部，以便向主要經營決策者（即
      chief operating decision maker (“CODM”) (i.e. the executive directors of        本公司之執行董事）呈報。提供獨立財務
      the Company). Individual operating segments for which discrete                  資料的個別經營分部由主要經營決策者鑒
      financial information is available are identified by the CODM and are           定並由其各自的管理團隊經營。該等個別
      operated by their respective management teams. These individual                 經營分部合計總額達致本集團可呈報分部。
      operating segments are aggregated in arriving at the reportable

      According to a joint circular of Ministry of Finance and State                    根據財政部、國家稅務總局聯合發佈財稅
      Administration of Taxation, Cai Shui [2008] No. 1, dividend distributed to        [2008]1 號通知，自 2008 年 1 月 1 日開始由中
      foreign investors out of the profits generated since 1 January 2008 by            國實體企業產生的溢利分配股息予外商投

42. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                         42. 資金風險管理
      The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will be      本集團管理其資金以確保本集團內各實體
      able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to              將能夠以持續經營方式營運，同時亦透過
      stakeholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.           達致債務與股權之間最佳平衡而為股東爭
      The Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged from prior year.                 取最大回報。本集團之總體策略由往年至
                                                                                      今維持不變。

      The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt which includes          本集團的資本架構由淨債務，包括分別於
      lease liabilities and bank borrowings disclosed in notes 29 and 31,             附註 29 及 31 披露之租賃負債及銀行借款，
      respectively, net of cash and cash equivalents, and equity attributable to      淨現金及現金等值以及本公司股權持有人
      owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital and reserves.            應佔權益（包括已發行股本及儲備）等組成。

      The directors of the Company review the capital structure periodically.         本公司董事定期檢討其資本架構。作為此
      As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the cost of       檢討之一部分，本公司董事考慮資金成本
      capital and the risks associated with each class of capital. The Group will     及各級別資金相關的風險。本集團透過派
      also balance its overall capital structure through the payment of               付股息、發行新股及回購股票，同時亦會
      dividends, new share issues and share buy-backs as well as the issue of         發 行 新 債 務 或 贖 回 現 有 債 務（如 需 要）以
      new debt or the redemption of existing debt, if necessary.                      平衡其整體資本架構。
